Housing loans remained a critical component of the retail lending portfolio. Conversely, lending to the services sector declined, highlighting slower growth in certain segments. This overall increase in several sectors points to an encouraging trend in the credit market.

banking-economy.title: Finmin asks pvt banks to increase participation in govt's financial inclusion schemes
banking-economy.summary: The Finance Ministry on Tuesday asked private sector banks to step up participation in financial inclusion schemes, including PMMY and Stand Up India. Financial Services Secretary Sanjay Lohiya urged banks to support the upcoming saturation campaign, expand digital outreach, improve loan processing, strengthen insurance claim awareness and address grievances.

sectors.title: ITC Infotech launches 'VANGUARDS': An elite forward- deployed engineering cadre to accelerate enterprise AI transformation
sectors.summary: ITC Infotech has launched the VANGUARDS program aimed at fostering high-potential engineers to drive AI transformation. This program connects technical expertise with business needs to achieve measurable outcomes. VANGUARDS engineers will work directly within client environments to enhance innovation and improve alignment between teams. The initiative reflects a shift from experimentation to scalable execution of AI solutions. Organizations can expect improved speed in realizing AI investments to achieve business impact.

sectors.title: Australia probes app used in cheap smart glasses over privacy fears
sectors.summary: Australia is investigating how and where the firm behind an app used in popular low-cost smart glasses collects and stores personal data, the country's data protection watchdog said Wednesday. "In the absence of any response from Shenzhen Qingcheng to the OAIC's preliminary inquiries, I have no assurance that it is protecting personal data of Australians as required by the Privacy Act," Privacy Commissioner Carly Kind said.
